thread:
incident-bot: Pager: MULTI-GPU_COMM_TIMEOUT for job job-17b3 on cluster gpu-pool-eu (node n-172-04). NCCL_COMM_TIMEOUT + container restart events. Customer impact: realtime-inference-prod (Acme) reporting ~30% 5xx errors. Incident channel created: #inc-3898765432

maria_g: ack, joining bridge now. tagging @eng_runtime @sre_oncall

kevin_r: I'm SSHing into n-172-04, grabbing kernel and container logs. kubectl shows pod job-17b3 in CrashLoopBackOff on gpu-2

kevin_r: kubectl logs job-17b3 -n inference --tail=200
```
NCCL WARN NCCL comm 0x7f9: TIMEOUT waiting at barrier
GPU 2: Xid 79 detected
cudaErrorInvalidDevice: launch failed
container runtime: reaped process, exit code 255
```

sre_oncall: Confirmed Pagerbot: metrics show spike in NCCL errors at 2026-06-10T14:02Z; 35% of multi-GPU jobs on pool-eu showing timeouts. CS ticket opened: INC-2026-Acme

eng_runtime: quick hypothesis: GPU reset (Xid 79) caused one rank to drop out, NCCL barrier never completes -> TP sync stall -> orchestrator retries -> container crash. Possible driver/tooling mismatch or thermal/hw fault. I'll join and look at nccl + nvml traces.

maria_g: running `dmesg | grep -i -E "NVRM|Xid"` on n-172-04
```
[Jun10 14:01:59] NVRM: GPU at PCI:0000:3b:00: GPU 0000:3b:00: Xid (PCI:0000:3b:00): 79, Channel 0
[Jun10 14:02:01] NVRM: GPU reset done.
```

kevin_r: journalctl -u containerd shows repeated segfaults around same time. containerd restarted twice. Also seeing nvidia-device-plugin complaining: device plugin failed to remove container devices

maria_g: attempted `kubectl drain n-172-04 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` but pods stuck Terminating because the device plugin holds mounts.

ops-bot: Cordon + drain initiated: `kubectl cordon n-172-04` -> success. Started `kubectl drain` -> some pods forcibly deleted, others in Terminating for >2m.

kevin_r: grabbed nvidia-smi -q output and gpu process list. GPU 2 shows last pid vanished but nvml reports stale handle. nvidia-smi log snippet:
```
GPU 2: Processes: none
Fan: 40% Temp: 84C
Compute processes show stale PID 41231 (zombie)
```

eng_runtime: immediate mitigations:
- route realtime-inference-prod to 1-GPU fallback model variant to reduce TP usage
- add env NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING=1, NCCL_TIMEOUT=300 to job template
- drain and reprovision node after ensuring coredumps captured
I'll push routing change now.

maria_g: Routing change applied via console: realtime-inference-prod -> model-1g-quant-v2 (canary then full). Tear down old canary in 2 minutes.

sre_oncall: after routing switch, error rate dropped from ~30% to 7% in 5m. So customer impact mitigated. Notify CS.

customer-success-liz: Update sent to Acme: "We're seeing multi-GPU sync failures causing intermittent errors. We've rolled a fallback to single-GPU model for realtime-inference-prod and are remediating the affected node. We'll follow up with a full RCA." Customer asked for hourly updates.

kevin_r: collected: `journalctl -k | tail -n 50`, `journalctl -u containerd -n 100`, `/var/log/nvidia-installer.log`, NCCL debug logs from pod (`/tmp/nccl_debug.log`). Pushed artifacts to /artifacts/inc-3898765432/

maria_g: attempting soft restart of device plugin and containerd on node (to release mounts):
```
sudo systemctl restart nvidia-device-plugin
sudo systemctl restart containerd
```
containerd crashed during restart once, then came up. Device plugin now shows healthy, but kubelet still marks some pods as Unknown for short time.

eng_runtime: preliminary analysis from logs: NCCL shows a rank hung in barrier after GPU reset. We see multiple ranks fail to re-establish communicator. Runtime currently doesn't reinit NCCL comms after NVML GPU reset -> stuck. Short-term: env toggles + routing. Medium-term: runtime change to detect Xid and force rank restart or reinit comms. Also check driver version: node reports driver 520.61, recommending 525.85 for better reset handling.

kevin_r: captured `cuda` stack trace from crashing container: shows `ncclGroupEnd` waiting on `ncclBarrier`. Will push stack to artifacts.

maria_g: drained node successfully after plugin restart. Evicted remaining pods. Node cordoned. Scheduling a maintenance reboot to pick up driver update.

ops-bot: Maintenance action created: MAINT-3898765432 on n-172-04, window 2026-06-10T16:00Z -> 17:00Z. Reboot + driver update planned.

sre_oncall: we should collect coredumps for containerd and offending process before reboot. Kevin, can you run coredumpctl save for the last PID?

kevin_r: saved coredump, uploaded to artifacts, and collected `/var/crash/` bundle. Also snapshot of /var/log/messages and kernel oops. Link: https://artifacts.internal/inc-3898765432

eng_runtime: creating a follow-up PR to gracefully handle NVML GPU resets: on GPU reset events, mark rank and attempt communicator teardown + reinit on orchestrator side. Also add detection to autoscaler to avoid re-scheduling multi-GPU jobs onto nodes with recent Xid 79.

maria_g: after draining and reboot, node came up clean. Reinstalled driver 525.85-1, restarted kubelet. Re-deployed job-17b3 to healthy node (n-172-09) and job warmed up normally. No NCCL errors observed post-move.

sre_oncall: customer: updated—fallback removed, job migrated to healthy nodes, throughput restored. CS confirmed reduced errors and system stable. Leaving incident open for RCA and follow-ups.

customer-success-liz: Acme acknowledged and asked for RCA by EOD tomorrow. I confirmed.

eng_runtime: immediate follow-ups:
- PR for communicator reinit (ENG-3899)
- Add Xid79 detector metric + alert (SRE-3900)
- Patch job template to include NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING env by default (DEPLOY-3910)

maria_g: created postmortem draft in Google Docs and linked to ticket. Notes include timeline, mitigation steps, artifacts, customer comms, and action items.

sre_oncall: final status: mitigated (routing fallback), node remediated (driver upgrade + reboot), jobs migrated, customer notified. ETA for RCA: 2026-06-11 18:00Z.

eng_runtime: adding note—need to test reinit logic in staging with forced NVML resets. Will schedule test next week.

maria_g: thanks all. If no further regressions in 2h I'll close this channel and mark incident resolved. :white_check_mark: 

kevin_r: leaving logs and artifacts in the folder. thumbs.

incident-bot: Incident updated: state=mitigated, severity=P2, cs_ticket=INC-2026-Acme, rca_doc=https://docs.internal/rca/3898765432

sre_oncall: closing bridge, moving to postmortem. Please add any lingering notes to the doc.

customer-success-liz: I'll keep Acme updated onsite. Good job everyone. :pray:
